# ResearchGate

> > ResearchGate is a professional network for scientists and researchers to share publications, collaborate, and discover scientific research.

ResearchGate connects millions of researchers worldwide, enabling them to share their work, access scientific publications, and collaborate across disciplines. The platform serves as a hub for academic networking, research discovery, and scientific communication.

## Key Topics

- Academic networking
- Scientific collaboration
- Research publications
- Scientific community
- Research discovery
- Publication access
- Researcher profiles
- Citation tracking
- Peer collaboration
- Scientific knowledge sharing

## Platform Overview

- [ResearchGate Homepage](https://www.researchgate.net/application.IndexContent.html): Main landing page for the academic networking and research collaboration platform, connecting researchers worldwide
